detail.longDescription:
Sometimes my work is helping someone who got blindsided by an unexpected shift in the Cybersecurity landscape. 

Sometimes my work is just helping someone "walk their perimeter" and "check their locks".

And sometimes, my work is helping a widely recognized subject matter expert, who is doing potentially life changing work. And well, I mostly help them "walk their perimeter" and "check their locks".

But it tends to be an awfully fun "walk".

I have received so many hilariously unnecessary apologies. 

I've heard "sorry you had to read my code and specification documents", so many times when that code and documentation was a fascinating delight.

Anyway, this was the kind of Friday morning that makes up for a week communicating about PHP patching.

#cybersecurity #academic #devops #friday
